reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico in 1 run: wiring, design checks, breadboard, PCB (DRC clean) and the simulator test, which reads red/IR/green FIFO counts and the die temperature exactly. The model uses the datasheet's FIFO (32 samples, 3-byte left-justified 18-bit, mode/rate/average/pulse-width fields), TINT+TFRAC temperature and self-clearing RESET/TEMP_EN; it assumes multi-LED slots 1-3 = red, IR, green, as the driver sets them.
